zh.text: $MAGS Mag7 ETF強勁，接近大型MACD買入觸發突破。如果NVDA在此消息見底且其他Mag7持續強勢，將進一步支持年底反彈。巨型科技股亦受惠於較高利率，因其擁有數十億現金賺取5%利率。

en.text: $MAGS Mag7 ETF strong and nearing a big MACD buy trigger breakout. If NVDA bottoms with this news and other Mag7 continue strength, it further supports year-end rally case. Mega tech benefit from higher rates as they have billions in cash earning 5%.

zh.text: EliteOptions2週五彩票交易計劃：$SPX和$QQQ今早有更大缺口下跌，但跌勢被買入。全天回調，但長時間停留在上週四低點以上確認底部形成。明天盤前有PPI數據。提及$AMD $MU $NVDA $QQQ $SMH $SPX。

en.text: EliteOptions2 trade plan for lotto Friday: $SPX and $QQQ had a bigger gap down this morning but the dip ended up being bought up. Both faded throughout the day but longer stay above last Thursday's lows confirms bottom forming. PPI numbers coming premarket tomorrow. Mentions $AMD $MU $NVDA $QQQ $SMH $SPX.

en.text: PunterJeff compares $SATA effective yield vs US Credit benchmarks since 4/15/26 last 25 BP rate increase, with credit yields climbing while Bitcoin -2%, $SPY +8.6% and $QQQ +8.3% over the period.

zh.text: 突發：美元延續漲幅+0.3%至新周期高位。我們在$UUP方面保持多頭。

en.text: BREAKING: The U.S. Dollar extends gains +0.3% to new Cycle Highs. We remain long in $UUP terms.

zh.text: $VLO $MPC $PSX $DK $CLMT 至少煉油廠沒有個人崇拜。此外，俄羅斯和中東的下游和中游資產繼續被炸毀。這東西，尤其是PADD 3重名，仍然有腿。

en.text: $VLO $MPC $PSX $DK $CLMT At least there is no cult of personality with the refiners. Plus, Russian and Middle East downstream and midstream assets continue getting blown up. This thing, especially the PADD 3 heavy names, still has legs.

zh.text: wallstengine 報導頂尖民主黨人士 Ron Wyden 和 Richard Neal 對特朗普政府如何處理 Nvidia $NVDA 芯片銷往中國展開調查。他們的信將 H200 關稅安排稱為「違憲的出口稅系統」。來源：TechCrunch。

en.text: wallstengine reports top Democrats Ron Wyden and Richard Neal opened an inquiry into how the Trump administration handled Nvidia $NVDA chip sales to China. Their letter calls the H200 tariff arrangement an 'unconstitutional export tax system'. Source: TechCrunch.

zh.text: 埃德·齊特龍聲稱關於價值約2000億美元晶片因數據中心未就緒而存放於倉庫的帖文來自其工作。引述 Sixth Street 行政總裁 Alex Waxman 稱 AI 需求真實，但庫存積壓可能導致 AI 支出錯配。提及 $GOOGL $META $MSFT $AMZN $ORCL。

en.text: Ed Zitron claims a post about $200 billion worth of chips sitting in warehouses because data centers aren't ready came from his work. Quoted CEO of Sixth Street, Alex Waxman, says AI demand is real but inventory buildup may cause a dislocation in AI spend. Mentions $GOOGL $META $MSFT $AMZN $ORCL.
